AdaptablePower.name: Adaptable
AdaptablePower.text: When this creature would be defeated, it instead revives even stronger.
AdaptablePower.text_zh: 当这个怪物将要被击败时，它会复活变得更加强大。

AfterimagePower.name: Afterimage
AfterimagePower.text: Whenever you play a card, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
AfterimagePower.text_zh: 你每打出一张牌，都获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

AggressionPower.name: Aggression
AggressionPower.text: At the start of your turn, put a random Attack from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it for the rest of combat.
AggressionPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，将你[gold]弃牌堆[/gold]的一张随机攻击牌放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]并将其在本场战斗中[gold]升级[/gold]。

ArsenalPower.name: Arsenal
ArsenalPower.text: Whenever you create a card, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
ArsenalPower.text_zh: 每当你生成一张牌，就获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

AutomationPower.name: Automation
AutomationPower.text_zh: 你每抽[blue]10[/blue]张牌时，获得[gold]能量[/gold]。

BackAttackLeftPower.name: Back Attack
BackAttackLeftPower.text: Deals [blue]50%[/blue] more damage when it is attacking you from behind.
BackAttackLeftPower.text_zh: 从后方对你攻击时，造成的伤害增加[blue]50%[/blue]。

BackAttackRightPower.name: Back Attack
BackAttackRightPower.text: Deals [blue]50%[/blue] more damage when it is attacking you from behind.
BackAttackRightPower.text_zh: 从后方对你攻击时，造成的伤害增加[blue]50%[/blue]。

BarricadePower.name: Barricade
BarricadePower.text: [gold]Block[/gold] is not removed at the start of this creature's turn.
BarricadePower.text_zh: [gold]格挡[/gold]不会在你的回合开始时被移除。

BattlewornDummyTimeLimitPower.name: Time Limit
BattlewornDummyTimeLimitPower.text: You have [blue]3[/blue] more turns to defeat the Battleworn Dummy.
BattlewornDummyTimeLimitPower.text_zh: 你还有[blue]3[/blue]个回合来击败战斗好伙伴。

BeaconOfHopePower.name: Beacon of Hope
BeaconOfHopePower.text: Whenever you gain [gold]Block[/gold] on your turn, other players gain half that much [gold]Block[/gold].
BeaconOfHopePower.text_zh: 每当你在你的回合获得[gold]格挡[/gold]时，其他玩家获得相应一半的[gold]格挡[/gold]。

BiasedCognitionPower.name: Biased Cognition
BiasedCognitionPower.text: At the start of your turn, lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Focus[/gold].
BiasedCognitionPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，失去[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]集中[/gold]。

BlackHolePower.name: Black Hole
BlackHolePower.text: Whenever you spend or gain {singleStarIcon}, deal [blue]3[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
BlackHolePower.text_zh: 每当你花费或获得{singleStarIcon}时，对所有敌人造成[blue]3[/blue]点伤害。

BlockNextTurnPower.name: Block Next Turn
BlockNextTurnPower.text: At the start of your next turn, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
BlockNextTurnPower.text_zh: 在你的下个回合开始时，获得[blue]4[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

BlurPower.name: Blur
BlurPower.text: [gold]Block[/gold] is not removed at the start of your next turn.
BlurPower.text_zh: 你的下一回合开始时[gold]格挡[/gold]不会消失。

BorrowedTimePower.name: Borrowed Time
BorrowedTimePower.text: Cards cost an additional Energy this turn.
BorrowedTimePower.text_zh: 卡牌在本回合耗能增加一。

BufferPower.name: Buffer
BufferPower.text: Prevent the next time you would lose HP.
BufferPower.text_zh: 阻止下一次你受到的生命值损伤。

BurrowedPower.name: Burrowed
BurrowedPower.text: [gold]Block[/gold] is not removed at the start of this creature's turn. [gold]Stunned[/gold] if all [gold]Block[/gold] is removed.
BurrowedPower.text_zh: [gold]格挡[/gold]不会在其回合开始时移除。如果所有[gold]格挡[/gold]被移除，则将其[gold]击晕[/gold]。

BurstPower.name: Burst
BurstPower.text: This turn, your next Skill is played an extra time.
BurstPower.text_zh: 本回合，你的下一张技能牌会多打出一次。

CalamityPower.name: Calamity
CalamityPower.text: Whenever you play an Attack, add a random Attack into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
CalamityPower.text_zh: 每当你打出一张攻击牌时，将一张随机攻击牌添加到你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

CalcifyPower.name: Calcify
CalcifyPower.text_zh: [gold]奥斯提[/gold]的攻击造成额外伤害。

CallOfTheVoidPower.name: Call of the Void
CallOfTheVoidPower.text: At the start of your turn, add [blue]1[/blue] random card into your [gold]Hand[/gold] and apply [gold]Ethereal[/gold] to it.
CallOfTheVoidPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，将[blue]1[/blue]张随机牌添加到你的[gold]手牌[/gold]并给予其[gold]虚无[/gold]。

ChainsOfBindingPower.name: Chains of Binding
ChainsOfBindingPower.text: The first [blue]3[/blue] cards drawn each turn are Afflicted with [gold]Bound[/gold].
ChainsOfBindingPower.text_zh: 每回合抽到的前[blue]3[/blue]张牌将会被侵蚀为[gold]魂缚[/gold]。

ClarityPower.name: Clarity
ClarityPower.text: At the start of your next turn, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card.
ClarityPower.text_zh: 在你的下一个回合开始时，额外抽[blue]1[/blue]张牌。

ColossusPower.name: Colossus
ColossusPower.text: You receive [blue]50%[/blue] less damage from [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] enemies this turn.
ColossusPower.text_zh: 本回合，你从[gold]易伤[/gold]敌人处受到的伤害减少[blue]50%[/blue]。

ConfusedPower.name: Confused
ConfusedPower.text: The costs of your cards are randomized on draw, from [blue]0[/blue] to [blue]3[/blue].
ConfusedPower.text_zh: 你的卡牌耗能会在抽取时变化，范围为[blue]0[/blue]到[blue]3[/blue]。

ConquerorPower.name: Conqueror
ConquerorPower.text: [gold]Sovereign Blade[/gold] deals double damage to the enemy this turn.
ConquerorPower.text_zh: [gold]君王之剑[/gold]在本回合对该敌人造成双倍伤害。

ConstrictPower.name: Constrict
ConstrictPower.text: While the Slithering Strangler is alive, at the end of your turn, take [blue]1[/blue] damage.
ConstrictPower.text_zh: 蛇行扼杀者存活时，在你的回合结束时受到[blue]1[/blue]点伤害。

ConsumingShadowPower.name: Consuming Shadow
ConsumingShadowPower.text: At the end of your turn, [gold]Evoke[/gold] your leftmost Orb.
ConsumingShadowPower.text_zh: 在你的回合结束时，[gold]激发[/gold]你最左侧的充能球。

CoolantPower.name: Coolant
CoolantPower.text: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] for each unique Orb you have.
CoolantPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，每有一种不同的充能球获得[blue]3[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

CorrosiveWavePower.name: Corrosive Wave
CorrosiveWavePower.text: Whenever you draw a card this turn, apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
CorrosiveWavePower.text_zh: 你在本回合每抽到一张牌，就给予所有敌人[blue]2[/blue]点[gold]中毒[/gold]。

CorruptionPower.name: Corruption
CorruptionPower.text:
Skills cost [blue]0[/blue].
Whenever you play a Skill, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it.
CorruptionPower.text_zh:
所有技能牌耗能变为[blue]0[/blue]。
所有技能牌在打出时被[gold]消耗[/gold]。

CountdownPower.name: Countdown
CountdownPower.text: At the start of your turn, apply [blue]6[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold] to a random enemy.
CountdownPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，给予随机敌人[blue]6[/blue]层[gold]灾厄[/gold]。

CoveredPower.name: Covered
CoveredPower.text: An ally is covering you. All attacks that would be directed to you are redirected to them instead.
CoveredPower.text_zh: 有盟友在掩护你。所有朝向你的攻击会被改为瞄准对方。

CrabRagePower.name: Crab Rage
CrabRagePower.text: When an ally dies, this creature gains [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]99[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
CrabRagePower.text_zh: 当有盟友死亡时，这个生物获得[blue]5[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]和[blue]99[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

CreativeAiPower.name: Creative AI
CreativeAiPower.text: At the start of your turn, add a random Power into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
CreativeAiPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，将一张随机能力牌添加到你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

CrimsonMantlePower.name: Crimson Mantle
CrimsonMantlePower.text: At the start of your turn, lose HP and gain [gold]Block[/gold].
CrimsonMantlePower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，失去生命并获得[gold]格挡[/gold]。

CrueltyPower.name: Cruelty
CrueltyPower.text_zh: 以上敌人受到额外伤害。

CurlUpPower.name: Curl Up
CurlUpPower.text: When damaged, rolls up and gains block. (Once per combat)
CurlUpPower.text_zh: 受到伤害时，蜷起身子并获得格挡。（每场战斗一次）

DampenPower.name: Dampen
DampenPower.text: While Magi Knight is alive, ALL your cards are [gold]Downgraded[/gold].
DampenPower.text_zh: 魔法骑士存活时，你的所有卡牌被[gold]降级[/gold]。

DanseMacabrePower.name: Danse Macabre
DanseMacabrePower.text: Whenever you play a card that costs [blue]2[/blue] Energy or more, gain [blue]7[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
DanseMacabrePower.text_zh: 每当你打出一张耗能为[blue]2[/blue]或更高的牌时，获得[blue]7[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

DarkEmbracePower.name: Dark Embrace
DarkEmbracePower.text: Whenever a card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
DarkEmbracePower.text_zh: 每当有一张牌被[gold]消耗[/gold]时，抽[blue]1[/blue]张牌。

DebilitatePower.name: Debilitate
DebilitatePower.text: [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold] are twice as effective for the next [blue]2[/blue] turns.
DebilitatePower.text_zh: [blue]2[/blue]回合内，[gold]易伤[/gold]和[gold]虚弱[/gold]的效果变为两倍。

DemesnePower.name: Demesne
DemesnePower.text: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold] and draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card.
DemesnePower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]能量[/gold]并额外抽[blue]1[/blue]张牌。

DemisePower.name: Demise
DemisePower.text: At the end of its turn, this creature X loses HP.
DemisePower.text_zh: 这个生物在其回合结束时失去生命。

DemonFormPower.name: Demon Form
DemonFormPower.text: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
DemonFormPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，获得[blue]2[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

DevourLifePower.name: Devour Life
DevourLifePower.text_zh: 每当你打出一张[gold]灵魂[/gold]时，[gold]召唤[/gold][blue]1[/blue]。

DexterityPower.name: Dexterity
DexterityPower.text_zh: 敏捷会增加从卡牌中获得的[gold]格挡[/gold]。

DiamondDiademPower.name: Diamond Diadem
DiamondDiademPower.text: Enemies deal [blue]50%[/blue] less damage this turn.
DiamondDiademPower.text_zh: 敌人在本回合造成的伤害减少[blue]50%[/blue]。

DieForYouPower.name: Die for You
DieForYouPower.text_zh: [gold]奥斯提[/gold]会吸收所有未被格挡的攻击伤害。

DisintegrationPower.name: Disintegration
DisintegrationPower.text: At the end of your turn, take [blue]5[/blue] damage.
DisintegrationPower.text_zh: 在你的回合结束时，受到[blue]5[/blue]点伤害。

DoomPower.name: Doom
DoomPower.text: At the end of the enemy turn, if it has at least as much Doom as HP, it dies.
DoomPower.text_zh: 在敌人的回合结束时，如果其灾厄值等于或大于其生命，则其直接死亡。

DoubleDamagePower.name: Double Damage
DoubleDamagePower.text: This turn, Attacks deal double damage.
DoubleDamagePower.text_zh: 本回合，攻击造成双倍伤害。

DrawCardsNextTurnPower.name: Draw Cards Next Turn
DrawCardsNextTurnPower.text: At the start of your next turn, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card.
DrawCardsNextTurnPower.text_zh: 在你的下回合开始时，额外抽[blue]1[/blue]张牌。

DuplicationPower.name: Duplication
DuplicationPower.text: Your next card is played an extra time.
DuplicationPower.text_zh: 你下一张打出的牌会多打出一次。

EchoFormPower.name: Echo Form
EchoFormPower.text: The first card you play each turn is played an extra time.
EchoFormPower.text_zh: 你每回合打出的第一张牌会多打出一次。

EnergyNextTurnPower.name: Energy Next Turn
EnergyNextTurnPower.text_zh: 在下回合额外获得[gold]能量[/gold]。

EnragePower.name: Enrage
EnragePower.text: Whenever you play a Skill, gains [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
EnragePower.text_zh: 每当你打出一张技能牌时，获得[blue]2[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

EntropyPower.name: Entropy
EntropyPower.text: At the start of your turn, [gold]Transform[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
EntropyPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，[gold]变化[/gold]你[gold]手牌[/gold]中的[blue]1[/blue]张牌。

EnvenomPower.name: Envenom
EnvenomPower.text: Whenever you deal unblocked attack damage, apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold].
EnvenomPower.text_zh: 每当你造成未被格挡的伤害时，给予[blue]1[/blue]层[gold]中毒[/gold]。

FeelNoPainPower.name: Feel No Pain
FeelNoPainPower.text: Whenever a card is Exhausted, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
FeelNoPainPower.text_zh: 每当有一张牌被消耗时，获得[blue]3[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

FeralPower.name: Feral
FeralPower.text: The first time you play a 0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} Attack each turn, return it to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
FeralPower.text_zh: 每回合你第一次打出0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}攻击牌时，将其放回你的[gold]手牌[/gold]中。

FlameBarrierPower.name: Flame Barrier
FlameBarrierPower.text: Whenever you are attacked this turn, deal [blue]4[/blue] damage back.
FlameBarrierPower.text_zh: 本回合你每次受到攻击时，反击造成[blue]4[/blue]点伤害。

FlankingPower.name: Flanking
FlankingPower.text: Other allies deal [blue]2x[/blue] the attack damage to this enemy this turn.
FlankingPower.text_zh: 其他盟友在本回合对这名敌人造成[blue]2倍[/blue]攻击伤害。

FlutterPower.name: Flutter
FlutterPower.text_zh: 从攻击牌中受到的伤害减少[gold]50%[/gold]。

ForbiddenGrimoirePower.name: Forbidden Grimoire
ForbiddenGrimoirePower.text: At the end of combat, remove a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ForbiddenGrimoirePower.text_zh: 在战斗结束时，从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中移除一张牌。

ForegoneConclusionPower.name: Foregone Conclusion
ForegoneConclusionPower.text: Next turn, put [blue]3[/blue] cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
ForegoneConclusionPower.text_zh: 下回合，将你[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]中的[blue]3[/blue]张牌放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

FrailPower.name: Frail
FrailPower.text: While Frail, gain [blue]25%[/blue] less [gold]Block[/gold] from cards.
FrailPower.text_zh: 脆弱时，从卡牌中获得的[gold]格挡[/gold]值减少[blue]25%[/blue]。

FreePowerPower.name: Free Power
FreePowerPower.text: The next Power you play costs [blue]0[/blue] {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
FreePowerPower.text_zh: 你的下一张能力牌耗能为[blue]0[/blue] {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。

FreeSkillPower.name: Free Skill
FreeSkillPower.text: The next Skill you play costs [blue]0[/blue] {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.

FriendshipPower.name: Friendship
FriendshipPower.text: Gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold] at the start of each turn.
FriendshipPower.text_zh: 每回合开始时获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]能量[/gold]。

FurnacePower.name: Furnace
FurnacePower.text: At the start of your turn, [gold]Forge[/gold] [blue]5[/blue].
FurnacePower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，[gold]铸造[/gold][blue]5[/blue]。

GenesisPower.name: Genesis
GenesisPower.text: At the start of your turn, gain {singleStarIcon}.
GenesisPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，获得{singleStarIcon}。

GigantificationPower.name: Gigantification
GigantificationPower.text: The next Attack you play deals triple damage.
GigantificationPower.text_zh: 你打出的下一张攻击牌造成三倍伤害。

GravityPower.name: Gravity
GravityPower.text: Whenever you play a card this turn, deal [blue]2[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
GravityPower.text_zh: 本回合，你每打出一张牌，对所有敌人造成[blue]2[/blue]点伤害。

GuardedPower.name: Guarded
GuardedPower.text_zh: 从敌人处受到的伤害减半。

HailstormPower.name: Hailstorm
HailstormPower.text: At the end of your turn, if you have [gold]Frost[/gold], deal [blue]6[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
HailstormPower.text_zh: 在你的回合结束时，如果你有[gold]冰霜[/gold]充能球，则对所有敌人造成[blue]6[/blue]点伤害。

HammerTimePower.name: Hammer Time
HammerTimePower.text: Whenever you [gold]Forge[/gold], all allies [gold]Forge[/gold] as well.
HammerTimePower.text_zh: 每当你[gold]铸造[/gold]时，所有盟友也[gold]铸造[/gold]相同数值。

HangPower.name: Hang
HangPower.text: All [gold]Hangs[/gold] deal [blue]2[/blue] times more damage to this enemy.
HangPower.text_zh: 所有[gold]吊杀[/gold]牌对这名敌人造成[blue]2[/blue]倍伤害。

HardToKillPower.name: Hard to Kill
HardToKillPower.text: Reduce all damage taken and HP lost by [gold]Exoskeleton[/gold] to [blue]9[/blue].
HardToKillPower.text_zh: [gold]外骨骼虫[/gold]受到的所有伤害和生命减少效果不会超过[blue]9[/blue]点。

HardenedShellPower.name: Hardened Shell
HardenedShellPower.text: This creature cannot lose more than [blue]20[/blue] HP each turn.
HardenedShellPower.text_zh: 这个生物每回合失去的生命值不会超过[blue]20[/blue]点。

HauntPower.name: Haunt
HauntPower.text: Whenever you play a [gold]Soul[/gold], a random enemy loses [blue]3[/blue] HP.
HauntPower.text_zh: 每当你打出一张[gold]灵魂[/gold]时，一个随机敌人失去[blue]3[/blue]点生命。

HeistPower.name: Heist
HeistPower.text: When killed, returns all the stolen [gold]Gold[/gold].
HeistPower.text_zh: 被击杀时，返还所有偷走的[gold]金币[/gold]。

HelloWorldPower.name: Hello World
HelloWorldPower.text: At the start of your turn, add [blue]1[/blue] random Common card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
HelloWorldPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，将[blue]1[/blue]张随机普通牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

HellraiserPower.name: Hellraiser
HellraiserPower.text: Whenever you draw a card containing "Strike", it is played against a random enemy.
HellraiserPower.text_zh: 每当你抽到名字中有“打击”的牌时，对一名随机敌人打出这张牌。

HexPower.name: Hex
HexPower.text: While Spectral Knight is alive, ALL your cards are [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
HexPower.text_zh: 幽灵骑士存活时，你的所有卡牌都拥有[gold]虚无[/gold]。

HighVoltagePower.name: High Voltage
HighVoltagePower.text: At the end of this creature's turn, it gains [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
HighVoltagePower.text_zh: 这个生物的回合结束时，会获得[blue]2[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

IllusionPower.name: Illusion
IllusionPower.text: When this dies, it revives next turn at full HP.
IllusionPower.text_zh: 死亡时，下回合会以完整生命值复活。

ImbalancedPower.name: Imbalanced
ImbalancedPower.text: If this creature's attacks are fully blocked by any player, it becomes [gold]Stunned[/gold].
ImbalancedPower.text_zh: 如果这个生物的攻击被任意玩家完全格挡，则它将被[gold]击晕[/gold]。

ImprovementPower.name: Improvement
ImprovementPower.text: At the end of combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a random card.
ImprovementPower.text_zh: 在战斗结束时，随机[gold]升级[/gold]一张牌。

InfernoPower.name: Inferno
InfernoPower.text: At the start of your turn, lose [blue]1[/blue] HP. Whenever you lose HP on your turn, deal [blue]4[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
InfernoPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，失去[blue]1[/blue]点生命。每当你在自己的回合中失去生命时，对所有敌人造成[blue]4[/blue]点伤害。

InfiniteBladesPower.name: Infinite Blades
InfiniteBladesPower.text: At the start of your turn, add a [gold]Shiv[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
InfiniteBladesPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，在你的[gold]手牌[/gold]中加入一张[gold]小刀[/gold]。

IntangiblePower.name: Intangible
IntangiblePower.text: Reduce all damage taken and HP loss to [blue]1[/blue] this turn.
IntangiblePower.text_zh: 将本回合受到的所有伤害和生命减少效果降低为[blue]1[/blue]。

InterceptPower.name: Intercept
InterceptPower.text: You are covering another player. All attacks that would be directed towards them are redirected towards you.
InterceptPower.text_zh: 你正在掩护另一名玩家。本回合所有对其发起的攻击都会转移到你的身上。

IterationPower.name: Iteration
IterationPower.text: The first time you draw a Status each turn, draw more cards.
IterationPower.text_zh: 每回合你第一次抽到状态牌时，抽更多牌。

JuggernautPower.name: Juggernaut
JuggernautPower.text: Whenever you gain [gold]Block[/gold], deal [blue]6[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
JuggernautPower.text_zh: 每当你获得[gold]格挡[/gold]时，对随机敌人造成[blue]6[/blue]点伤害。

JugglingPower.name: Juggling
JugglingPower.text: Add a copy of the third Attack you play each turn into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
JugglingPower.text_zh: 将你在每回合打出的第三张攻击牌的复制品加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

KnockdownPower.name: Knockdown
KnockdownPower.text: This creature takes [blue]{Amount}[/blue] times the damage from other players this turn.
KnockdownPower.text_zh: 该敌人在本回合受到的来自其他玩家的伤害变为[blue]{Amount}[/blue]倍。

LeadershipPower.name: Leadership
LeadershipPower.text: All other allies deal [blue]1[/blue] additional damage.
LeadershipPower.text_zh: 所有其他盟友造成[blue]1[/blue]点额外伤害。

LethalityPower.name: Lethality
LethalityPower.text: The first Attack each turn deals 50% additional damage.
LethalityPower.text_zh: 每回合的第一张攻击牌会造成50%额外伤害。

LightningRodPower.name: Lightning Rod
LightningRodPower.text: At the start of the next [blue]2[/blue] turns, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Lightning[/gold].
LightningRodPower.text_zh: 在下[blue]2[/blue]个回合开始时，[gold]生成[/gold][blue]1[/blue]个[gold]闪电[/gold]充能球。

LoopPower.name: Loop
LoopPower.text: At the start of your turn, trigger the passive ability of your next Orb.
LoopPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，触发你最右侧充能球的被动能力。

MachineLearningPower.name: Machine Learning
MachineLearningPower.text: At the start of your turn, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card.
MachineLearningPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，额外抽[blue]1[/blue]张牌。

MagicBombPower.name: Magic Bomb
MagicBombPower.text: Take [blue]20[/blue] damage at the end of your turn. Is cleared if the Magi Knight dies.
MagicBombPower.text_zh: 在你的回合结束时受到[blue]20[/blue]点伤害。如果魔法骑士死亡，消除这一效果。

MasterPlannerPower.name: Master Planner
MasterPlannerPower.text: When you play a Skill, it gains [gold]Sly[/gold].
MasterPlannerPower.text_zh: 当你打出技能牌时，该牌获得[gold]奇巧[/gold]。

MayhemPower.name: Mayhem
MayhemPower.text: At the start of your turn, play the top card of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
MayhemPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，打出你[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]顶部的牌。

MinionPower.name: Minion
MinionPower.text: Minions abandon combat without their leader.
MinionPower.text_zh: 爪牙会在他们的领导者死亡时放弃战斗。

MonarchsGazePower.name: Monarch's Gaze
MonarchsGazePower.text: Whenever you attack an enemy, it loses [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
MonarchsGazePower.text_zh: 每当你攻击敌人时，这名敌人在本回合失去[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

MonologuePower.name: Monologue
MonologuePower.text: Whenever you play a card this turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
MonologuePower.text_zh: 每当你在本回合打出卡牌时，在本回合获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

NecroMasteryPower.name: Necro Mastery
NecroMasteryPower.text: Whenever [gold]Osty[/gold] loses HP, ALL enemies lose that much HP as well.
NecroMasteryPower.text_zh: 每当[gold]奥斯提[/gold]失去生命值时，所有敌人失去等量生命值。

NemesisPower.name: Nemesis
NemesisPower.text: At the end of every other turn, gains [gold]Intangible[/gold] [blue]1[/blue].
NemesisPower.text_zh: 每两个回合结束时，获得[blue]1[/blue]层[gold]无实体[/gold]。

NeurosurgePower.name: Neurosurge
NeurosurgePower.text: At the start of your turn, apply [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
NeurosurgePower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，给予自身[blue]3[/blue]层[gold]灾厄[/gold]。

NightmarePower.name: Nightmare
NightmarePower.text: Add [blue]3[/blue] of a chosen card into your [gold]Hand[/gold] next turn.
NightmarePower.text_zh: 在下个回合，将所选牌的[blue]3[/blue]张复制品加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

NoBlockPower.name: No Block
NoBlockPower.text_zh: 你无法从卡牌中获得[gold]格挡[/gold]。

NoDrawPower.name: No Draw
NoDrawPower.text: You may not draw any more cards this turn.
NoDrawPower.text_zh: 你在本回合无法再抽更多牌。

NoEnergyGainPower.name: No Energy Gain
NoEnergyGainPower.text: You cannot gain additional {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} this turn.
NoEnergyGainPower.text_zh: 你在本回合无法再获得更多{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。

NostalgiaPower.name: Nostalgia
NostalgiaPower.text: The first Attack or Skill you play each turn is placed on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
NostalgiaPower.text_zh: 每回合被打出第一张攻击或技能牌，将其放置于你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]顶端。

NoxiousFumesPower.name: Noxious Fumes
NoxiousFumesPower.text: At the start of your turn, apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
NoxiousFumesPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，给予所有敌人[blue]2[/blue]层[gold]中毒[/gold]。

OblivionPower.name: Oblivion
OblivionPower.text: Whenever you play a card, this enemy gains [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold].
OblivionPower.text_zh: 你在本回合内每打出一张牌，就给予该敌人[blue]1[/blue]层[gold]灾厄[/gold]。

OneTwoPunchPower.name: One-Two Punch
OneTwoPunchPower.text: Your next Attack is played an extra time this turn.
OneTwoPunchPower.text_zh: 本回合，你的下一张攻击牌会多打出一次。

OrbitPower.name: Orbit
OrbitPower.text: Every [blue]4[/blue] Energy you spend, gain an Energy.
OrbitPower.text_zh: 你每花费[blue]4[/blue]点能量，就获得[blue]1[/blue]点能量。

OutbreakPower.name: Outbreak
OutbreakPower.text: Every [blue]10[/blue] times you apply [gold]Poison[/gold], deal damage to ALL enemies.
OutbreakPower.text_zh: 你每给予[gold]中毒[/gold][blue]10[/blue]次时，对所有敌人造成伤害。

PagestormPower.name: Pagestorm
PagestormPower.text: Whenever you draw an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card, draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
PagestormPower.text_zh: 每当你抽到一张[gold]虚无[/gold]牌时，抽[blue]1[/blue]张牌。

PainfulStabsPower.name: Painful Stabs
PainfulStabsPower.text: Shuffle [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Wound[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] each time you receive unblocked attack damage.
PainfulStabsPower.text_zh: 每次你受到未被格挡的伤害时，将[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]伤口[/gold]洗入你的[gold]弃牌堆[/gold]。

PaleBlueDotPower.name: Pale Blue Dot
PaleBlueDotPower.text: If you play enough cards in a turn, draw additional cards at the start of your next turn.
PaleBlueDotPower.text_zh: 当你在一回合内打出足够数量的牌时，就在下一回合开始时额外抽牌。

PanachePower.name: Panache
PanachePower.text: If you play [blue]5[/blue] cards this turn, deal damage to ALL enemies.
PanachePower.text_zh: 如果你在本回合内打出[blue]5[/blue]张牌，则对所有敌人造成伤害。

PaperCutsPower.name: Paper Cuts
PaperCutsPower.text: Whenever this creature deals unblocked attack damage to you, you lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold].
PaperCutsPower.text_zh: 每当这个生物对你造成未被格挡的伤害时，你失去[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]最大生命[/gold]。

PersonalHivePower.name: Personal Hive
PersonalHivePower.text: Whenever this enemy is hit by an Attack, add [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
PersonalHivePower.text_zh: 每当这个敌人被攻击命中时，在你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]中加入[gold]晕眩[/gold]。

PhantomBladesPower.name: Phantom Blades
PhantomBladesPower.text:
[gold]Shivs[/gold] gain [gold]Retain[/gold].
The first [gold]Shiv[/gold] you play each turn deals [blue]9[/blue] additional damage.
PhantomBladesPower.text_zh:
[gold]小刀[/gold]获得[gold]保留[/gold]。
你每回合打出的第一张[gold]小刀[/gold]伤害增加[blue]9[/blue]。

PillarOfCreationPower.name: Pillar of Creation
PillarOfCreationPower.text: Whenever you create a card, gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
PillarOfCreationPower.text_zh: 每当你创造一张牌时，获得[blue]5[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

PlatingPower.name: Plating
PlatingPower.text: At the end of your turn, gain [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Plating[/gold] is reduced by [blue]1[/blue] at the start of your turn.
PlatingPower.text_zh: 在你的回合结束时获得[gold]格挡[/gold]。[gold]覆甲[/gold]会在你的回合开始时减少[blue]1[/blue]层。

PlowPower.name: Plow
PlowPower.text: The first time this creature's HP reaches [blue]150[/blue] or below, it becomes [gold]Stunned[/gold].
PlowPower.text_zh: 这个生物的生命值第一次下降到[blue]150[/blue]或更低时，将其[gold]击晕[/gold]。

PoisonPower.name: Poison
PoisonPower.text: Poisoned creatures lose HP at the start of their turn. Each turn, Poison is reduced by [blue]1[/blue].
PoisonPower.text_zh: 中毒的生物会在自身回合开始时失去生命。中毒层数每回合减少[blue]1[/blue]。

PossessSpeedPower.name: Possess Speed
PossessSpeedPower.text: When killed, return all stolen [gold]Dexterity[/gold] to the player.
PossessSpeedPower.text_zh: 被击杀时，将偷窃的所有[gold]敏捷[/gold]返还给玩家。

PossessStrengthPower.name: Possess Strength
PossessStrengthPower.text: When killed, return all stolen [gold]Strength[/gold] to the player.
PossessStrengthPower.text_zh: 被击杀时，将偷窃的所有[gold]力量[/gold]返还给玩家。

PrepTimePower.name: Prep Time
PrepTimePower.text: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold].
PrepTimePower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，获得[blue]4[/blue]点[gold]活力[/gold]。

PyrePower.name: Pyre
PyrePower.text: Gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold] at the start of each turn.
PyrePower.text_zh: 在每回合开始时获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]能量[/gold]。

RadiancePower.name: Radiance
RadiancePower.text_zh: 在下回合额外获得1点[gold]能量[/gold]。

RagePower.name: Rage
RagePower.text: Whenever you play an Attack this turn, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
RagePower.text_zh: 本回合，你每打出一张攻击牌就获得[blue]3[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

RampartPower.name: Rampart
RampartPower.text: At the start of the player's turn, Turret Operator gains [blue]25[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
RampartPower.text_zh: 在玩家回合开始时，高塔炮手获得[blue]25[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

RavenousPower.name: Ravenous
RavenousPower.text: When an enemy dies, Corpse Slug immediately eats it, becoming [gold]Stunned[/gold] and gaining [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
RavenousPower.text_zh: 当有敌人死亡时，噬尸蛞蝓会立即吃下尸体，在本回合被[gold]击晕[/gold]然后获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

ReaperFormPower.name: Reaper Form
ReaperFormPower.text: Whenever Attacks deal damage, apply that much [gold]Doom[/gold].
ReaperFormPower.text_zh: 每当你的攻击造成伤害时，同时给予等量的[gold]灾厄[/gold]。

ReattachPower.name: Reattach
ReattachPower.text: If other segments are still alive, revives in [blue]2[/blue] turns with [blue]25[/blue] HP.
ReattachPower.text_zh: 如果身体还有存活的其他部分，则在[blue]2[/blue]回合后以[blue]25[/blue]点生命复活。

ReboundPower.name: Rebound
ReboundPower.text: The next card you play this turn is placed on the top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
ReboundPower.text_zh: 将你在本回合打出的下一张牌放置到你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]顶部。

ReflectPower.name: Reflect
ReflectPower.text: Blocked damage is reflected to your attacker.
ReflectPower.text_zh: 被格挡的伤害会反弹到攻击者身上。

RegenPower.name: Regen
RegenPower.text: [gold]Regen[/gold] heals HP at the end of your turn. Each turn, [gold]Regen[/gold] is reduced by [blue]1[/blue].
RegenPower.text_zh: [gold]再生[/gold]会在你的回合结束时回复相应生命。每回合[gold]再生[/gold]的数值会减少[blue]1[/blue]。

RingingPower.name: Ringing
RingingPower.text: You can only play [blue]1[/blue] card this turn.
RingingPower.text_zh: 本回合你只能打出[blue]1[/blue]张牌。

RitualPower.name: Ritual
RitualPower.text: Gain [gold]Strength[/gold] at the end of your turn.
RitualPower.text_zh: 在你的回合结束时获得[gold]力量[/gold]。

RollingBoulderPower.name: Rolling Boulder
RollingBoulderPower.text: At the start of your turn, deal [blue]5[/blue] damage to ALL enemies and increase this damage by [blue]5[/blue].
RollingBoulderPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，对所有敌人造成[blue]5[/blue]点伤害，然后将此伤害增加[blue]5[/blue]。

RoyaltiesPower.name: Royalties
RoyaltiesPower.text: At the end of combat, gain [blue]25[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
RoyaltiesPower.text_zh: 在战斗结束时，获得[blue]25[/blue][gold]金币[/gold]。

RupturePower.name: Rupture
RupturePower.text: Whenever you lose HP on your turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
RupturePower.text_zh: 每当你在自身回合失去生命时，获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

SandpitPower.name: Sandpit
SandpitPower.text: A power used by The Insatiable.

SeekingEdgePower.name: Seeking Edge
SeekingEdgePower.text_zh: [gold]君王之剑[/gold]现在会对所有敌人造成伤害。

SentryModePower.name: Sentry Mode
SentryModePower.text: At the start of your turn, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Sweeping Gaze[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SentryModePower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，将[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]扫荡凝视[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

SerpentFormPower.name: Serpent Form
SerpentFormPower.text: Whenever you play a card, deal [blue]4[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
SerpentFormPower.text_zh: 你每打出一张牌，就对随机一名敌人造成[blue]4[/blue]点伤害。

ShadowStepPower.name: Shadow Step
ShadowStepPower.text: Next turn, Attacks deal double damage.
ShadowStepPower.text_zh: 在下个回合，攻击造成双倍伤害。

ShadowmeldPower.name: Shadowmeld
ShadowmeldPower.text_zh: 本回合你获得的[gold]格挡[/gold]值翻倍。

ShriekPower.name: Shriek
ShriekPower.text: The first time this creature's HP reaches [blue]50%[/blue] or below, it becomes [gold]Stunned[/gold].
ShriekPower.text_zh: 这个生物的生命值第一次降到[blue]50%[/blue]或以下时，会被[gold]击晕[/gold]。

ShrinkPower.name: Shrink
ShrinkPower.text: This creature's Attacks deal [blue]30%[/blue] less damage for the next 3 turns.
ShrinkPower.text_zh: 这个生物的攻击伤害在3回合内减少[blue]30%[/blue]。

ShroudPower.name: Shroud
ShroudPower.text_zh: 你每次给予[gold]灾厄[/gold]时，获得[blue]3[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

SicEmPower.name: Sic 'Em
SicEmPower.text: Whenever [gold]Osty[/gold] hits this enemy this turn, [gold]Summon[/gold] [blue]3[/blue].
SicEmPower.text_zh: 本回合，每当[gold]奥斯提[/gold]命中这个敌人时，[gold]召唤[/gold][blue]3[/blue]。

SignalBoostPower.name: Signal Boost
SignalBoostPower.text: Your next Power is played an extra time.
SignalBoostPower.text_zh: 你的下一张能力牌会额外打出一次。

SkittishPower.name: Skittish
SkittishPower.text: The first time this creature is hit each turn, it gains [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
SkittishPower.text_zh: 这个生物每回合第一次被命中时，获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

SleightOfFleshPower.name: Sleight of Flesh
SleightOfFleshPower.text: Whenever you apply a debuff to an enemy, they take [blue]13[/blue] damage.
SleightOfFleshPower.text_zh: 每当你给予一个敌人负面状态时，使其受到[blue]13[/blue]点伤害。

SlipperyPower.name: Slippery
SlipperyPower.text: The next time this creature loses HP, it only loses [blue]1[/blue] HP instead.
SlipperyPower.text_zh: 这个生物下一次要失去生命值时，只会失去[blue]1[/blue]点生命。

SlothPower.name: Sloth
SlothPower.text: You cannot play more than [blue]3[/blue] cards each turn.
SlothPower.text_zh: 你在每个回合不能打出超过[blue]3[/blue]张牌。

SlowPower.name: Slow
SlowPower.text: Whenever you play a card, this enemy receives [blue]10%[/blue] more damage from Attacks this turn.
SlowPower.text_zh: 你在本回合内每打出一张牌，该敌人本回合从攻击牌中受到的伤害增加[blue]10%[/blue]。

SlumberPower.name: Slumber
SlumberPower.text: Awakens upon taking turns or losing HP 3 times.
SlumberPower.text_zh: 在一定回合经过后或失去生命3次后苏醒。

SmoggyPower.name: Smoggy
SmoggyPower.text: You can only play [blue]1[/blue] Skill per turn.
SmoggyPower.text_zh: 每回合你只能打出[blue]1[/blue]张技能牌。

SmokestackPower.name: Smokestack
SmokestackPower.text: Whenever you create a Status, deal damage to ALL enemies.
SmokestackPower.text_zh: 每当你生成一张状态牌时，对所有敌人造成伤害。

SneakyPower.name: Sneaky
SneakyPower.text: Whenever another player attacks an enemy, gain [gold]Block[/gold].
SneakyPower.text_zh: 每当另一名玩家攻击敌人时，获得[gold]格挡[/gold]。

SoarPower.name: Soar
SoarPower.text: Receives [gold]50%[/gold] less attack damage until it lands.
SoarPower.text_zh: 在落地之前受到的伤害减少[gold]50%[/gold]。

SpectrumShiftPower.name: Spectrum Shift
SpectrumShiftPower.text: At the start of your turn, add [blue]1[/blue] random Colorless card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SpectrumShiftPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，将[blue]1[/blue]张随机无色牌添加到你的[gold]手牌[/gold]中。

SpeedsterPower.name: Speedster
SpeedsterPower.text: Whenever you draw a card during your turn, deal [blue]1[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
SpeedsterPower.text_zh: 每当你在回合中抽到一张牌时，对所有敌人造成[blue]1[/blue]点伤害。

SpinnerPower.name: Spinner
SpinnerPower.text: At the start of your turn, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Glass[/gold].
SpinnerPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，[gold]生成[/gold][blue]1[/blue]个[gold]玻璃充能球[/gold]。

SpiritOfAshPower.name: Spirit of Ash
SpiritOfAshPower.text: Whenever you play an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
SpiritOfAshPower.text_zh: 每当你打出一张[gold]虚无[/gold]牌时，获得[blue]4[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

StampedePower.name: Stampede
StampedePower.text: At the end of your turn, [blue]1[/blue] random Attack in your [gold]Hand[/gold] is played against a random enemy.
StampedePower.text_zh: 在你的回合结束时，随机打出你[gold]手牌[/gold]中的[blue]1[/blue]张攻击牌攻击随机敌人。

SteamEruptionPower.name: Steam Eruption
SteamEruptionPower.text: When killed, deals damage at the end of your next turn.
SteamEruptionPower.text_zh: 被击杀时，在你的下一回合结束时造成伤害。

StockPower.name: Stock
StockPower.text: When killed, a new Axebot is summoned in its place.
StockPower.text_zh: 被击杀时，召唤一个全新的巨斧机器人。

StormPower.name: Storm
StormPower.text_zh: 你每打出一张能力牌，就[gold]生成[/gold][blue]1[/blue]个[gold]闪电充能球[/gold]。

StranglePower.name: Strangle
StranglePower.text: Whenever you play a card this turn, this enemy loses [blue]2[/blue] HP.
StranglePower.text_zh: 本回合，你每次打出牌时，这名敌人失去[blue]2[/blue]点生命。

StratagemPower.name: Stratagem
StratagemPower.text: Whenever you shuffle your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], choose [blue]1[/blue] card from it to put into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
StratagemPower.text_zh: 你每次洗牌[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]时，从中选择[blue]1[/blue]张牌放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

StrengthPower.name: Strength
StrengthPower.text: Strength adds additional damage to Attacks.
StrengthPower.text_zh: 力量会增加攻击牌造成的伤害。

SubroutinePower.name: Subroutine
SubroutinePower.text: Whenever you play a Power, gain [blue]1[/blue] {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
SubroutinePower.text_zh: 你每次打出能力牌时，都获得[blue]1[/blue]{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。

SuckPower.name: Suck
SuckPower.text: Whenever this creature deals unblocked attack damage, it gains [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
SuckPower.text_zh: 这个生物每次造成未被格挡的伤害时，都会获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

SummonNextTurnPower.name: Summon Next Turn
SummonNextTurnPower.text: At the start of your next turn, [gold]Summon[/gold] [blue]2[/blue].
SummonNextTurnPower.text_zh: 在你的下回合开始时，[gold]召唤[/gold][blue]2[/blue]。

SurprisePower.name: Surprise
SurprisePower.text: Something is off about this creature...
SurprisePower.text_zh: 这个生物有点不太对劲……

SurroundedPower.name: Surrounded
SurroundedPower.text: Receive [blue]50%[/blue] more damage if attacked from behind. Use targeting cards or potions to change your orientation.
SurroundedPower.text_zh: 被从后方攻击时受到的伤害增加[blue]50%[/blue]。使用有目标的卡牌或药水来改变你的朝向。

SwipePower.name: Swipe
SwipePower.text: Upon killing this enemy, the stolen card is returned.
SwipePower.text_zh: 击杀这名敌人时，会取回被偷走的卡牌。

TagTeamPower.name: Tag Team
TagTeamPower.text: The next Attack another player plays on the enemy is played {Amount:plural:an extra time|[blue]{}[/blue] extra times}.
TagTeamPower.text_zh: 另一名玩家对该敌人的下一张攻击牌会多打出[blue]{Amount}[/blue]次。

TaintedPower.name: Tainted
TaintedPower.text: Take additional damage from Attacks this turn.
TaintedPower.text_zh: 在本回合受到额外的攻击伤害。

TangledPower.name: Tangled
TangledPower.text_zh: 本回合，攻击牌的[gold]能量[/gold]费用增加[blue]1[/blue]。

TankPower.name: Tank
TankPower.text: Take double damage from enemies. Allies take half damage from enemies.
TankPower.text_zh: 自身受到敌人伤害加倍。盟友受到敌人伤害减半。

TenderPower.name: Tender
TenderPower.text: Whenever you play a card, lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
TenderPower.text_zh: 本回合，你每打出一张牌，就失去[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]和[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

TerritorialPower.name: Territorial
TerritorialPower.text: At the end of this creature's turn, it gains [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
TerritorialPower.text_zh: 这个生物在自身回合结束时，会获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

TheBombPower.name: The Bomb
TheBombPower.text: At the end of [blue]3[/blue] turns, deal [blue]40[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
TheBombPower.text_zh: 在第[blue]3[/blue]回合结束时，对所有敌人造成[blue]40[/blue]点伤害。

TheGambitPower.name: The Gambit
TheGambitPower.text: If you take unblocked attack damage this combat, die.
TheGambitPower.text_zh: 如果你在这场战斗中受到未被格挡的攻击伤害，则立即死亡。

TheHuntPower.name: The Hunt
TheHuntPower.text: Gain [blue]1[/blue] additional card reward at the end of combat.
TheHuntPower.text_zh: 在战斗结束时额外获得[blue]1[/blue]份卡牌奖励。

TheSealedThronePower.name: The Sealed Throne
TheSealedThronePower.text: Whenever you play a card, gain {singleStarIcon}.

ThornsPower.name: Thorns
ThornsPower.text: When hit by an attack, deal damage back.
ThornsPower.text_zh: 当被攻击命中时，反击造成伤害。

ThunderPower.name: Thunder
ThunderPower.text: Whenever you [gold]Evoke Lightning[/gold], deal [blue]8[/blue] damage to each enemy hit.
ThunderPower.text_zh: 每当你[gold]激发闪电充能球[/gold]时，对命中的敌人造成[blue]8[/blue]点伤害。

ToolsOfTheTradePower.name: Tools of the Trade
ToolsOfTheTradePower.text: At the start of your turn, draw [blue]1[/blue] card and discard [blue]1[/blue] card.
ToolsOfTheTradePower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，抽[blue]1[/blue]张牌并丢弃[blue]1[/blue]张牌。

ToricToughnessPower.name: Toric Toughness
ToricToughnessPower.text: Gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] at the start of the next [blue]2[/blue] turns.
ToricToughnessPower.text_zh: 在下[blue]2[/blue]个回合开始时获得[blue]5[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

TrackingPower.name: Tracking
TrackingPower.text: [gold]Weak[/gold] enemies take [blue]2[/blue] times more damage from Attacks.
TrackingPower.text_zh: [gold]虚弱[/gold]的敌人从攻击牌中受到[blue]2[/blue]倍伤害。

TrashToTreasurePower.name: Trash to Treasure
TrashToTreasurePower.text: Whenever you create a Status, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] random Orb.
TrashToTreasurePower.text_zh: 每当你生成状态牌的时候，随机[gold]生成[/gold][blue]1[/blue]个充能球。

TyrannyPower.name: Tyranny
TyrannyPower.text: At the start of your turn, draw a card and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card from your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TyrannyPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，抽一张牌然后[gold]消耗[/gold]你的一张[gold]手牌[/gold]。

UnmovablePower.name: Unmovable
UnmovablePower.text: The first time you gain [gold]Block[/gold] from a card each turn, double the amount gained.
UnmovablePower.text_zh: 每个回合你第一次从卡牌中获得[gold]格挡[/gold]时，将数值翻倍。

VeilpiercerPower.name: Veilpiercer
VeilpiercerPower.text: The next [gold]Ethereal card[/gold] you play costs [blue]0[/blue].
VeilpiercerPower.text_zh: 你打出的下一张[gold]虚无[/gold]牌耗能为[blue]0[/blue]。

ViciousPower.name: Vicious
ViciousPower.text_zh: 每当你给予[gold]易伤[/gold], 抽[blue]1[/blue]张牌。

VigorPower.name: Vigor
VigorPower.text: Your next Attack deals additional damage.
VigorPower.text_zh: 你的下一张攻击牌伤害增加。

VoidFormPower.name: Void Form
VoidFormPower.text: The first [blue]2[/blue] cards you play each turn are free to play.
VoidFormPower.text_zh: 每回合你打出的前[blue]2[/blue]张牌会免费打出。

VulnerablePower.name: Vulnerable
VulnerablePower.text: Vulnerable creatures take [blue]50%[/blue] more damage from Attacks.
VulnerablePower.text_zh: 易伤的生物从攻击中受到的伤害增加[blue]50%[/blue]。

WasteAwayPower.name: Waste Away
WasteAwayPower.text_zh: 每回合获得的[gold]能量[/gold]减少[blue]1[/blue]点。

WeakPower.name: Weak
WeakPower.text: Weakened creatures deal [blue]25%[/blue] less damage with Attacks.
WeakPower.text_zh: 虚弱的生物造成的攻击伤害减少[blue]25%[/blue]。

WellLaidPlansPower.name: Well-Laid Plans
WellLaidPlansPower.text: At the end of your turn, [gold]Retain[/gold] up to [blue]1[/blue] card.
WellLaidPlansPower.text_zh: 在你的回合结束时，[gold]保留[/gold]最多[blue]1[/blue]张手牌。

WitheringPresencePower.name: Withering Presence
WitheringPresencePower.text: Every [blue]6[/blue] cards you play, add a [gold]Wither[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
WitheringPresencePower.text_zh: 你每打出[blue]6[/blue]张牌，将一张[gold]凋萎[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

WraithFormPower.name: Wraith Form
WraithFormPower.text: At the start of your turn, lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
WraithFormPower.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，失去[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。
